title: Card encoding: bijective map between cards and group elements
description: Deterministic bijective encoding from card IDs to prime-order group elements for SRA. Must be reversible after decryption, deterministic across clients, handle 32-136 card decks. Consider hash-to-group or sequential assignment with domain separation.
close_reason: Bijective card encoding: card i → (i+2) as BigUint, reversible decode. Bounded by MAX_DECK_SIZE=256. Tests pass.
